why: Analysis 1's hedgehog (one iconic brand image carried into every market, profit per brand) sits closer to the key's brand-building and profit-per-global-brand-category concept, and its verdict is tighter and more decisive; both cover the concentrate-and-stop-diversifying decision and the size and health-report facts equally. Analysis 2 is slightly more careful with facts (it correctly counts three recent acquisitions where Analysis 1 says four) and flags more uncertainty, but its profit-per-thousand denominator and 30/100 rating fit the key less well.
